13-13.solution: In opposite directions they close at \(25\) m/s and meet every \(\frac{1000}{25} = 40\) s. In 300 s that is \(7\) complete meetings (the 8th would be at 320 s).

13-26.solution: A takes \(\frac{500}{10} = 50\) s. In 50 s B runs \(8 \times 50 = 400\) m from its 50 m start, reaching 450 m, so A wins by \(50\) m.
